q1_issues.issue: Two `Name` atoms are hung on one symbol ("Pustnic River" and "Orociu River"), against the rule that a proper noun gets exactly one Name fact — the alias "or" has no licensed encoding, so the alternative name is recorded in a form the instruction set forbids.

q2_gaps: alias/appositive "or" — "The X or Y is ..." with singular agreement names ONE entity by two names; the Disjunction section covers only propositional "or" (which would wrongly split the subject) and the naming rule allows exactly one Name per entity, so a two-named entity is unrepresentable
notes: `PartOf` for "a tributary of the River Oraciu" is defensible — the instruction set cites that exact phrase as an ordinary genitive "untouched by" the geography-is-LocatedIn rule — though the part/component test over two rivers is a close call against `Possession`. The trailing "in Romania" is attached to the subject rather than to the River Oraciu; both attachment sites are coherent, so this sits near the Interpretation attachment trigger.
